title: On the Turán number of blow-ups of $\mathcal{F}_5$
summary: Let $\mathcal{F}_5$ denote the $3$-uniform hypergraph on the vertex set $\{f_1,f_2,\dots,f_5\}$ with hyperedges $\{f_1f_2f_3,f_1f_2f_4,f_3f_4f_5\}$. Recently, Balogh, Clemen and Luo determined the Turán number of a one-vertex blow-up of $\mathcal{F}_5$, more specifically, they blow up the vertex $f_5$ to $t$ vertices, the resulting hypergraph is denoted by $\mathcal{F}_5(f_5;t)$. They show that for infinitely many $t$, $\mathcal{F}_5(f_5;t)$ has exponentially many extremal constructions and positive Turán density. In this paper, we determine the exact Turán number of the hypergraph obtained…
